notes: Scenes R3 G1 STATION + TRAIN (research/sprint-0930/scenes-r3/PLAN.md, G1-NOTES.md). Runs right after variant-v2, so the beat numbers are variant-v2's own.

One background per line: 1 station-gate-r3 (ref 12, 4:30 overcast, board 4:30 -> OR) | 2 station-ads (ref 11, NAND駅, WATCHING YOU) | 3 station-ads-insert (ref 11 crop + IC gate, sharp) | 4 train-sun (ref 13, 4:40) | 5 train-rain (ref 14, 5:20 rain) | 6 platform-rain (ref 09/08/10, OR駅, her empty spot).
